package.name: robot_ui
package.description: Operator UI for the mobile manipulator: data collection, manual arm teaching, task control, calibration. Integration only — it owns no device and opens no hardware. Every capability it exposes is reached over ROS from the node that owns the device (arm_node, basler_camera_node, lifter_node, mobile_node, inference_node, task_executor). Two fronts on one RosBridge: robot_ui_web_node.py serves the UI as a web page to every computer on the site LAN (the default since 2026-09-15), robot_ui_node.py is the same UI as a PyQt window on the robot PC's own screen.
